Mission Local reported that Alemany Farm’s one-time city funding ran out, leaving it with a projected $100,000–$150,000 budget gap. The farm paused paid apprenticeships, reduced staff hours and launched a fundraising campaign. The story also reported that HSA later approved a grant extension through June 2026.
